svg.title: Kernel ridge regressor
svg.desc: A kernel ridge regressor predicts the training mean 7.418 plus a weighted sum of the Gaussian kernel, gamma 0.25 similarity to each stored training row. Each row is drawn on the standardised scale and coloured by whether its dual weight pulls nearby predictions up or down; hover for the weight. The axes are the two principal components of the stored rows: the first is led by amount +0.7, velocity +0.7, merchant_risk -0.09; the second is led by account_age +0.7, merchant_risk -0.7, velocity -0.09.
